# Reflect

**Problem:** lessons from a session — corrections received, assumptions that failed, commands re-derived — evaporate when the context window closes.

**Why useful:** this skill mines the session transcript with two fresh-context reviewers, filters their findings through a synthesis battery, and routes each surviving lesson to a concrete edit on a skill the session actually used — behind a user approval gate, never auto-applied.

**Scope:** session retrospection and skill-edit routing. It proposes edit content and target paths; it does not run this repo's sync / test / export pipeline.

**Use:** invoke `/reflect` in Claude Code or `$reflect` in Codex at the end of a session worth learning from. Follow the bundle-local [installation guidance](../INSTALL.md).
